title: Distilling an aligned Jev system into a classifier you own

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reached copywriting. article.md is a complete draft (about 2,850 words including two tables), copy-edited through one Limatus round (scan, a decision on every finding, hand rewrites, verify = accept) plus an editor's pass. Structure: stake and headline, flywheel in two paragraphs with links to the fine-tuning and confidence pieces, the six-step process, results (student against teacher, soft against hard labels, the per-slice gate, the cascade that did not help, cost and latency), the label-source comparison against a DistilBERT trained directly on the 140 labels, the relation to text-classifier-distillation, a ship checklist, the operating model, what we haven't tested, make student. Distillation figures were recomputed from studies/distill.jsonl and match the public README. One open hole, marked [result pending]: calibration figures for the direct fine-tune, held until that study's calibration step is checked. The direct fine-tune's accuracy figures come from the fine-tune-Laya study, which is not merged into the public README yet; they need confirming against the merged record before publication. Site MDX, five body images, cover and chart script are drafted in the Anth.us working tree (state: draft). Stops here: final editorial approval is Ryan's.
